name_note: Genomes that GTDB places in Sodaliphilus are often deposited under broader NCBI labels such as uncultured Prevotellaceae bacterium; only sources that name Sodaliphilus are used here.

sentences.text: In pig faecal metagenomes, an uncultured Sodaliphilus species was among the most widely distributed metagenome-assembled genomes.
A goat kid gastrointestinal microbial catalogue reported that Sodaliphilus was among the taxa that expanded the microbial tree of life in goat kids.
In the rumen, a diet with higher rumen-degradable protein content was reported to selectively enrich Sodaliphilus and other protein degraders.
A study comparing faecal samples from patients with rectal neuroendocrine tumours and healthy individuals identified Sodaliphilus pleomorphus among biomarkers with significant discriminatory value.
